# Harbor 1.9

Released 4 August 2026.

## New

- `harbor logs --release <release-id>` follows one release's output while it
  starts.
- Set `[health].timeout` to give slow apps longer to pass their health check.

## Changed

- `harbor deploy` prints the release ID before the build starts, so you can
  follow it from another terminal.

## Fixed

- Custom domains with uppercase letters now get a certificate.
